title: Pin reference_schnorr48.addr_for_key to the yggdrasil_address.json anchor (oracle tripwire test)
description: From i72x.6.a security codereview (reviewer model): reference_schnorr48.addr_for_key / ReferenceIdentity.ygg_addr is the generation-side oracle for root_dio_signature.json, tunnel_authorization.json, gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.json etc., but nothing pins it to the pinned upstream anchor — anchor tests only cover lichen.crypto.identity.yggdrasil_address (python/tests/crypto/test_yggdrasil_address_vectors.py:74) and Rust lichen-core. A future regression in the reference would flow silently into regenerated corpora. Add a small parametrized test asserting addr_for_key(anchor pubkey from test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json upstream_addr_for_key vector).hex() == anchor address, plus the 31/33-byte ValueError error-case vectors. Function is byte-exact today (verified against live yggdrasil-go at pinned commit 422836ee); this is a tripwire, not an active bug.
